newsitem.title: USA: Texas Star says judge halts excavation.
newsitem.headline: Texas Star says judge halts excavation.

text.p: Texas Star Resources Corp, a diamond exploration company, said on Monday that a U.S. District Judge granted a restraining order to temporarily halt excavation of bulk sample trenches in the Crater of Diamonds State Park in Arkansas.
A hearing is scheduled for 1030 EDT/1430 GMT Wednesday, October 23, 1996, in Little Rock, Ark.
Texas Star has been permitted to explore the park by the U.S. Department of Interior and the State of Arkansas.
However, an environmental group, Friends of the Crater of Diamonds, filed for a restraining order against the company.

Harry Hamlin, deputy attorney general of the State of Arkansas, will be handling the case to remove the restraining order and Texas Star has retained counsel to intervene on the company's behalf, the company said.
